fields.statement: Verifier at 5fe205c8d: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api/... ./internal/adapter/claudecode/... -run UsageScan passes (TestUsageScanOncePerPoll); also -race -count=2, ./internal/adapter/... in full and ./internal/api -run Usage pass, go vet clean. The test uses a fake ctx.Now clock and 120 transcripts and counts claudecode.UsageScanStats walks and reads across polls that each call usageRecordsFor twice (two projects): first poll 1 walk, 120 reads; 10s later 0 walks, 0 reads; one file appended 1 read, 0 walks; a new file within the minute is not walked, and the poll a minute later does 1 walk and 1 read and picks it up; final records reflect.DeepEqual a full UsageRecords read. Diff read: usageRecordsFor passes ctx.Now() to the new adapter.UsageReaderAt; the claude-code adapter walks a root at most once per usageWalkEvery (1m), otherwise Lstats only its known files and rereads only size/mtime changes, dropping vanished ones.
